terms.comment: The noun is dōdrāns, dōdrantis m.

phrases.english: It’s a quarter to two (1:45: one o’clock and three quarters).

phrases.latin: hōrā duodēvīcēsimā et dōdrante jūs facitō
phrases.english: at a quarter to six in the evening (17:45), make the gravy

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 81, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
Theodōrus et pater: Culīna Theodōrī, the recipe book that goes with the libellī (Ad Libellōs I–VII); examples marked “Culīna Theodōrī” quote it word for word.
